Limit.description: Maximum number of items. The default is 15.
Limit.name: limit

Name.description: Filters by a partial match in the full name.
Name.name: name

NextCursor.description: Cursor returned by the previous page.
NextCursor.name: next_cursor

Forbidden.description: The manager lacks permission or the account is disabled.

AdminToken.description: JWT issued by `POST /admin/sign-in`. Send it directly, without `Bearer`. Roles are checked on the server: MIN/MID/MAX for general operations and MAX for privileged administration.
AdminToken.name: Authorization

info.description: Gym management API. It provides administration of managers, memberships, users, and sales statistics. Protected operations expect the JWT directly in the `Authorization` header, without the `Bearer` prefix.
info.title: GymSystem API

get.description: Returns a simple response to verify that the service is running.
Lists managers ordered by email. Pagination uses the last item's email as the cursor. Requires the MAX role.

patch.description: Enables the specified account. Requires MAX.

delete.description: Disables the specified account. Requires MAX.
Permanently deletes the specified account. Requires MAX.

get.description: Returns the public information for the manager associated with the token. Available to MIN, MID, and MAX managers.

patch.description: Updates the phone number and/or role. If `email` is provided, the specified manager is updated; otherwise, the authenticated manager is updated. Requires MAX.

get.description: Returns the complete profile, including status, creation date, and last sign-in. Requires MAX.

patch.description: Changes the authenticated manager's password after verifying the previous password. Available to MIN, MID, and MAX managers.

post.description: Validates credentials and returns a JWT valid for approximately 20 hours. The token must be sent directly as `Authorization` in subsequent requests.
Creates a manager account. Only a MAX manager can register another account.

get.description: Lists plans ordered by identifier. Available to MIN, MID, and MAX managers.

post.description: Creates a new plan. The identifier must be unique. Requires MAX.

delete.description: Deletes the specified plan. Requires MAX.

get.description: Returns the requested plan details. Available to MIN, MID, and MAX managers.

patch.description: Updates one or more plan fields. Requires MAX.

get.description: Queries sales grouped by year, month, and membership. All filters are optional. Requires MAX.
Returns statistics for the current month or for a specific membership. Requires MAX.

200.description: A single statistic when filtering by membership; otherwise, an array of statistics.

get.description: Lists users ordered by ID and allows filtering by name. Available to MIN, MID, and MAX managers.

post.description: Registers a user and records the sale of the selected membership. The membership must already exist.

get.description: Validates the user's membership, status, and enabled state. If access is granted, records the visit and returns the remaining days.

403.description: Access denied because the membership has expired or the user is banned, deactivated, or disabled.

patch.description: Marks the user as `ACTIVE` and enables the account.
Marks the user as `BANNED` and disables the account.
Marks the user as `DEACTIVATED` and disables the account.

get.description: Returns the user's basic operational data.

patch.description: Updates one or more of the user's contact details.

get.description: Returns all stored user data, including payments, visits, and enabled status.

patch.description: Changes the user's plan, recalculates the next payment date, and records the sale.

tags.description: Membership plans available to gym users.
tags.name: Membership

tags.description: Registration, lookup, and status management for gym users.
tags.name: User

tags.description: Statistics about memberships sold and revenue collected.
tags.name: Statistics
